title: Queue runner must keep silent compiler phases alive without lane heartbeats
body: A queued cmake --build ../build/wsl was killed after 200 seconds with 180 seconds of no output while g++ compiled BuildRenderGraph.cpp (exit 75, no compiler diagnostic). A task-local heartbeat every 60 seconds let the same incremental build continue. The queue should emit or accept a supervised heartbeat for long compiler phases without requiring each lane to wrap its own build command; workaround: reports/travdefault/reproduce/build-wsl-with-heartbeat.sh:4.

title: Provision the per-lane native VIXEN checkout before dispatch
body: The assigned native path /mnt/c/vixen-native/travdefault did not exist; git -C status exited 128 before the native witness. Recovery cloned the lane branch with git clone --no-hardlinks --branch lane-travdefault and added an idempotent provision step to reports/travdefault/reproduce/native-build.sh. The lane preparer should create the native checkout and copy its Windows preset before dispatch.

title: Reuse one provisioned Vulkan SDK across VIXEN worktrees
body: A fresh cmake --preset vixen-wsl configure in a new worktree downloaded the full 1.4.350.1 SDK (about 320 MB) into VIXEN/.vulkan-sdk. Other worktrees repeat the same provision even when the version is already present elsewhere. Let presets resolve a shared versioned SDK cache before downloading per-worktree.

title: Add a short correctness mode to the look-dev capture fixture
body: The Dozen fallback witness is correctness-only, but the capture fixture hardcodes 64 frames per angle. On the software Vulkan driver that took about 14 seconds per frame, making four-angle shader/backend validation take close to an hour. Add a bounded test-only frame-count control; the lane added VIXEN_LOOKDEV_CAPTURE_FRAMES with the 64-frame default preserved and used 1 for the Dozen witness.

title: Fast-forward the native lane before invoking fetched helpers
body: The native build helper fetched lane-travdefault but launched a .bat from the stale checkout before merging FETCH_HEAD, so Windows failed with 'The system cannot find the path specified.' Recovery moves git merge --ff-only FETCH_HEAD into the WSL runner before cmd.exe starts. The native runner should fast-forward its assigned checkout before invoking scripts from that branch.
